metadata.title: Famous Fish And Rice of Sarna Hotel in Ranchi | सरना होटल का मछली-भात | The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
Join us on an exciting culinary adventure as we delve into the heart of Jharkhand's tribal heritage at Sarna Hotel, located in the vibrant city of Ranchi. In this special episode of Tribal Kitchen, we had the privilege of stepping into the world of mouthwatering flavors and cultural richness that define the renowned Sarna Hotel.

Run by a tribal owner from the esteemed Oraon community, Sarna Hotel is renowned for its legendary fish and rice dishes that have captivated locals and visitors alike. Passed down through generations, their unique recipes incorporate a secret ingredient that adds an enigmatic twist to their delectable fish preparations
